experiment: Direct state-dependent trajectory CP validation v1

training.basis: all total-degree <=2 monomials of standardized features
training.regression: linear-program quantile regression at tau=0.90; L1 coefficient regularization 0.001, intercept unpenalized
training.target: raw residual L2 norm divided by median training residual norm

success_criteria.engineering: planner returns a finite usable plan and full image-based rollouts finish
success_criteria.statistical: report trajectory coverage separately for reference-policy test and replanned-policy test, random and stress split; no automatic policy-transfer guarantee

non_goals: repair old polynomial by multiplying a coefficient
claim pointwise state coverage or a universal safety theorem
